messages:
Olivia R: hey everyone, i'm Olivia (new joiner in data infra). following the observability onboarding but getting stuck: Grafana shows "permission denied" when opening /d/inference/overview and Datadog Log Explorer gives 403. Sentry link for inference-runtime returns "no access". my SSO is olivia.r@redwood.ai — any tips?

devex-bot: welcome @Olivia R! please paste your email and which dashboards/projects you need. docs here: https://internal.redwood/docs/observability-onboard. if it's urgent tag @Infra Observability. :wave:

Olivia R: email above. primary needs: Grafana folder "inference" (view only), Datadog logs for inference-prod, and Sentry project inference-runtime-prod view. thanks!

Ben S: hey @Olivia R congrats! two quick checks: 1) try an incognito window (cookie loops happen), 2) confirm Okta lists you in redwood-observability. i can add grafana perms and trigger a SCIM sync for datadog.

Olivia R: incognito still errors. Okta shows me in redwood-engineers and redwood-observability.

Ben S: thanks. kicking a manual SCIM sync and refreshing Grafana ACLs for olivia.r@redwood.ai now.

Infra Observability: queued provisioning job for olivia.r@redwood.ai (job id: p-2026-03-23-42). we'll add grafana-viewers + datadog-log-read and send Sentry project invite if owners allow.

Olivia R: grafana access works now — can see the overview dashboard :tada:. Datadog explorer still 403. Sentry invite not arrived yet.

Ben S: for Datadog 403s we often see the role not applied to the api token mapping. can you run this quick check (replace token from vault):

```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "DD-API-KEY: <workspace-token>" "https://api.datadoghq.com/api/v1/logs-queries/list"
```

Olivia R: returns 403 when i use the vault token.

Infra Observability: i see the SCIM sync finished but the datadog role assignment hit a transient identity-service conflict. manually granted datadog-log-read to olivia.r@redwood.ai and resent a Sentry invite to inference-runtime-prod. should be immediate.

SRE Oncall: FYI there was a short window earlier where SCIM writes retried and caused duplicates; we've hardened the retry logic. shouldn't affect new users now.

Olivia R: Datadog explorer works now — 200 on the curl test. Sentry invite arrived and accepted. thanks so much for the quick help!

Olivia R: quick follow-up: who owns the inference/overview dashboard? i'd like to add p95 and p99 latency metrics and a short panel note about how p99 is affected by cold starts. don't want to touch alerts without verifying.

Infra Observability: dashboards are owned by infra-observability. small visual changes (adding p95/p99 lines, tooltip edits) are fine via a PR to repos/infrastructure/grafana-dashboards with the exported JSON. alert changes require review: open a short RFC in #observability-dashboards and tag @Infra Observability and @SRE Oncall so we can assess noise risk. if you want temporary grafana-editor rights to preview edits, request it here and we'll grant for 24h.

Olivia R: could i get temporary editor for 6h to prototype? i'll open a PR and tag everyone for review before merging.

Ben S: granted grafana-editor to olivia.r@redwood.ai for 6h. please remember to export JSON and add a comment about why p99 is necessary for tail behavior.

Olivia R: thanks! opening a tiny PR now and will follow the review process. appreciate the smooth onboarding :heart:
